IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: BLCI BREAKS THE CYCLE OF POVERTY THROUGH EDUCATION IN UNDERSERVED COMMUNITIES.
IRS990.MissionDesc: BLCI BREAKS THE CYCLE OF POVERTY BY PREPARING DISADVANTAGED STUDENTS TO BE AMONG THE FIRST IN THEIR FAMILIES TO ATTEND AND SUCCEED IN COLLEGE. BLCI ENSURES THAT 100% OF ITS STUDENTS ENROLL IN COLLEGE AND SUPPORTS THEM THROUGHOUT THEIR STUDIES.
IRS990.Desc: BLCI PROVIDES CHILDREN FROM UNDERSERVED COMMUNITIES THE INFORMATION AND OPPORTUNITIES NEEDED TO ENROLL IN COLLEGE AND HELP THEM BE SUCCESSFUL WHILE THERE. THE GOAL IS TO CHANGE THE QUESTION OF WHETHER THESE CHILDREN WILL GO TO COLLEGE TO WHERE WILL THEY GO TO COLLEGE. BLCI PROVIDES COACHING FROM ADULTS WHO KNOW WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE THE FIRST IN THEIR FAMILIES TO GO TO COLLEGE, PROVIDES COLLEGE PREP THROUGH AFTER SCHOOL PROGRAMS THAT BEGIN IN 3RD GRADE, AND REQUIRE 30 HOURS PER YEAR OF PARENT PARTICIPATION TO ENSURE FAMILY COMMITMENT TO ADVANCE THEIR CHILDREN'S EDUCATIONAL ASPIRATIONS. BLCI OFFERS INDIVIDUALIZED, CULTURALLY RELEVANT SERVICE TO EACH FAMILY. TO DATE, 100% OF BLCI STUDENTS ENROLL IN COLLEGE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION FOR THE ORGANIZATION'S CEO AND COO ARE DETERMINED BY REVIEWING SALARY DATA FROM ONLINE SOURCES FOR OTHER CEO'S AND COO'S IN THE REGION WITH SIMILIAR QUALIFICATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES TO GAIN COMPARABILITY DATA. IN ADDITION, A MARKET COMPENSATION ANALYSIS WAS IMPLEMENTED FOR ALL COMPENSATION PAID BY THE ORGANIZATION. THE FULL BOARD VOTES FOR APPROVAL. THIS PROCESS WAS LAST DONE NOVEMBER 2022.
